text: {"findings":[{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Generative AI and photo data use lack required review","detail":"The proposal generates instructions from past pickup photos, which involves generative AI and possibly personal data (people, faces, license plates in photos). No legal, privacy, or AI review is recorded; only a dependency on the store systems team is listed.","evidence_quote":"Generate store-specific pickup instructions from past pickup photos and show them in the driver app.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Record privacy/data-protection and generative AI policy reviews, including photo handling (PII redaction) and content-quality checks, before launch."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Self-selected markets, short duration, and mismatched MDE","detail":"Volunteer markets compared against the remaining markets is not randomized and introduces selection bias. The 3-week duration is above 14 days but is shorter than the 10-week success window. The 1-point MDE on a metric whose target change is $0.15 on $7.40 is not aligned with the expected effect.","evidence_quote":"Run a pilot in the markets whose managers volunteer and compare against the remaining markets. Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 1 point, power 80%.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Randomize at an appropriate unit (e.g., store or market-matched assignment), define the MDE in the primary metric's units to match the expected effect, and align the duration with the success timeframe."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Guardrails incomplete for driver-facing instruction change","detail":"Only Delivery Defect Rate is listed. A change to driver pickup guidance should also guard against pickup time/wait time, delivery time or on-time rate, and driver experience or safety signals. Their absence leaves key harms unmonitored.","evidence_quote":"Delivery Defect Rate: stop if it rises by more than 0.2 points.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as pickup/dwell time, on-time delivery rate, and driver support contacts or driver satisfaction."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Problem claim lacks quantified evidence and baseline source","detail":"The problem cites a survey but gives no figures on how much associate or driver time is lost. The $7.40 Cost Per Delivery baseline has no source.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: from $7.40 to $7.25 within 10 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the source of the $7.40 baseline and quantify the problem, for example the share of pickups affected by counter-finding delays."}]}
